_rules: THE DISCLOSURE REGISTER — every commercial relationship RichenQuest holds, and the basis of each. Constitution Article 5.4 requires this to be public AND surfaced at the point of recommendation, not buried in a policy page. Interface-agnostic: the website renders it, the matcher checks it before showing a result, and the CRM, dashboard and partner portal read the same file. Adding a relationship here is what makes it disclosable; a relationship that exists commercially but is absent here is a governance breach, not an oversight.

_policy.independence: No recommendation may be influenced, in fact or appearance, by any relationship listed here. A recommendation is independent when it can be reproduced from documented criteria that reference no commercial term (Constitution 5.1).
_policy.compensation_firewall: No individual's pay, bonus, quota or review at RichenQuest varies according to which institution, country, employer or programme a person selects (Constitution 5.3). The company may hold differential arrangements; the adviser never feels them.
_policy.identical_terms: Any payment from an institution is at a published rate identical across all institutions — no volume tiers, no bonuses, no preferential placement (Constitution 13.1).
_policy.steering_refused: Requests for preferential placement, quotas or focus are declined and recorded here. We decline the request, not the relationship (Constitution 5.6).

_relationships_note: EMPTY BY FACT, NOT BY OMISSION. RichenQuest currently holds no signed commercial agreement with any university, employer, institution or government. This mirrors claims.json → partnerships.signed, which is also empty. The machinery below is live: when the first agreement is signed it is added here, and every interface begins disclosing it automatically at the point of recommendation, with no code change.
_revenue_note: Today RichenQuest is funded by fees paid by the individuals it advises. That fee is published (evidence.json → standard-package-fee).
no_relationship_statement: We hold no commercial relationship with this destination or any institution in it.
